description: MIN, 2005 June regular phase: 54 of 54 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 54 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 54 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20251013162254: 54 listed, 54 matched to MLB's picks by name (3 by surname in the same round: #165 MLB "Steve Tolleson" / "Steven Tolleson"; #315 MLB "Matthew Betsill" / "Matt Betsill"; #1213 MLB "Charlie Leesman" / "Charles Leesman")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
